tweets.text:
WANTED AGGRAVATED FELON ARRESTED!
6/17- USBP agents assisted La Joya PD locate a wanted subject and previously deported aggravated felon in Rio Grande City, TX. After failing to yield to local authorities, this Mexican national attempted to flee on foot and threatened to shoot law enforcement if confronted. USBP agents jumped in to assist and he was soon apprehended.

His criminal record:
🔸Alien in possession of a firearm
🔸DWI
🔸Multiple removals from the U.S.
🔸Known Paisas gang member
🔸Documented human & narcotics smuggler

He now faces charges for a 3rd degree felony - evading arrest. An immigration detainer is in place for prosecution of felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Foreign criminal history:
🔴Leader of a criminal organization
🔴Convicted of human smuggling across the Greek-Turkish border
🔴Served 9 years in prison out of the 25-year sentence
🔴Admitted to working with the Russian KGB

U.S. Arrests:
🔴Arrested for petty theft in Feb 2024
🔴Possession of stolen goods in Feb 2024

He didn't waste any time breaking the law- just 7-months in the U.S. and already participating in criminal behavior. He's now pending removal proceedings.

ILLEGAL ALIEN TRIES TO RUN OVER A BP AGENT!

SAN JUAN, PR- On 6/25, USBP agents spotted a suspicious vehicle parked in an area notorious for illicit activity. As they approached, the smell of marijuana filled the air- the driver was too busy smoking to answer questions. Then, the driver sped off, accelerating towards the agents and nearly running them over. The driver ultimately crashed into a Border Patrol vehicle. IT DIDN'T END THERE... The two individuals jumped out of the car attempting to flee on foot- they were immediately apprehended. 

The driver, an illegal alien from the Dominican Republic now faces charges for assault on a federal agent and will be processed as an inadmissible alien.

Assaulting USBP agents is a FELONY- it will not be tolerated.

PRISON ESCAPEE ARRESTED!

6/20- USBP agents, in San Juan, PR, apprehended a fugitive who has an active arrest warrant for escaping from the New York Department of Corrections in 1994! The Dominican national has felony convictions for attempting criminal sale of a controlled substance and possession of a weapon. He is now in custody awaiting extradition and will be processed as an inadmissible illegal alien (8USC1182).

He thought he could hide in paradise but thanks to our agents, he's back where he belongs- BEHIND BARS.
@USBPChiefRMY
